value.signature: fn run (mut prepared : Prepared) -> Result < Value , AdapterFailure >

review.body: { prepared . controller . advance (Event :: Installed) . map_err (| _ | AdapterFailure :: Configuration) ? ; let actions = prepared . controller . advance (Event :: Continue) . map_err (| _ | AdapterFailure :: Configuration) ? ; match actions . as_slice () { [Action :: Complete { .. }] => selected_completion (actions , & mut prepared . controller) , [Action :: Construct] => { let construction = prepared . controller . construct_context () . map_err (| _ | AdapterFailure :: Configuration) ? ; match construction { Ok (context) => run_served (prepared , context) , Err (error) => { let actions = prepared . controller . advance (Event :: Constructed { result : Err (error) , at : elapsed_ns (prepared . clock) , }) . map_err (| _ | AdapterFailure :: Configuration) ? ; complete_retirement (& mut prepared , actions) } } } _ => Err (AdapterFailure :: Configuration) , } }
